claim_ceiling: No SURVIVES claim justified. Maximum justified: Docker substrate am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping@sha256:3e8cb9b945 is LIVE at 1280x720 with Playwright 1.63.0 + BrowserGym 0.14.3 + AgentLab 0.4.2 + CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree yielding 20/20 valid AX trees (668-1426 nodes, 196958-251734 bytes) on 10 families x2 captures. For longest-prefix full-tree semantic/multi-anchor without [:20] truncation on WebArena-Verified v2 shopping at this storefront, within-store AX_consistency on sampled 10 families is MEASUREMENT_INVALID due to product-page scarcity (2/10 families <5 required; 8/10 homepage captures identical). Bounded FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING characteristics observed on this sample: mean 0.8 with bootstrap CI [0.5,1.0] lower not >0.5, trajectory-grouped shuffle p=1.0 (not <0.05), delta vs truncated 0.0 (<0.10 and <0.20 vs prior 0.2857), indicating full-tree provides no discriminating same-mechanism signal over truncation/random for homepage-dominated sampling and longest-prefix metric is degenerate (binary 0/1). Stagehand selector+relevant-subtree SHA recomputed after mutation remains MEASUREMENT_INVALID: HIT 0.0 (<0.8) with full DOM SHA instability between reloads (relevant-subtree not tested), MISS/false_accept/speedup~2x/~30% and derived-selector-only beats-NC4 not measured at n>=30; per-project isolation PASS (0 leakage) and selector derivation feasible are descriptive only. WebGym 300k diverse holdout and deduplication sweep not measured (LIMITED); Gate0 multi-step H>0.1 NL>=20 titles>=1 census not measured (9 transitions). No cross-site, no within-store transfer, no product-economics promotion. Next test requires shopping_admin 184-task/42-family expansion, relevant-subtree normalized SHA, and BrowserGym loopback >=50 transitions/family.
